subject: Re: Genomics OOD - resourcing and budget
body:
Deshawn,

Closing the loop before Q3 OKRs lock on 6/26. Decisions:

1. Scope stays bacteria-benchmark only for the July LRB pre-read. The human-microbiome extension moves to Q4 - I would rather show one clean 0.755 AUROC story than two half-done ones.
2. Go ahead and book the reserved slice for July against B-44 as planned. Idris, if the earmark paperwork is not countersigned by end of week please tell us - the OKR writeup names that line explicitly.
3. Nikhil's standing mutation-rate sweep is approved; fold the ~8 GPU-day refresh cost into the same line.

Yara should have the eval review deck to me by 7/8 so I can circulate before the pre-read.

Viktor
